g.text: A call from inside the same bean skips the proxy, as with @Transactional. An unknown limiter name stops the application at startup.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The proxy is applied before the one of @Retryable, so the retry wraps it and every attempt takes a permit.
